name: Isis
source:
"I'm Isis. You're Kusakabe Kiichi...? Hehe, we'll be friends for a long time. Nice to meet you."

A mysterious girl with beautiful silver hair and tanned skin who calls herself an agent of "Neo Vatican." Even with Cameo's investigation, her true identity remains unknown. But she has a sexy body.

Her favorite things are super sweet sweets and super spicy food (especially curry). Her hobby is collecting cosmetics and accessories.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara8]official website[/url]]
